{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the presence of the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any rows have status 'refunded'
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")"}
